subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: Language practice – What's this? It's a … + Sound o
outcomes: I can ask and answer: What's this? It's a …
I can name things in my classroom.
I can hear the o sound in on, octopus and ox.

tf.s: We answer What's this? with It's a …
tf.why: Yes! What's this? – It's a door.

tf.s: Octopus starts with the o sound.
Fish starts with the o sound.
tf.why: Fish starts with f. Octopus starts with o.

tf.s: s – o – ck makes the word sock.
h – o – p makes the word mop.
tf.why: h-o-p makes hop. m-o-p makes mop.
A window is a thing. A teacher is a person.

tf.s: On starts with the letter o.
We answer What's this? with Goodbye.
tf.why: We answer with It's a … and the thing.

tf.s: A whiteboard is in the classroom.
tf.why: Yes! The teacher writes on the whiteboard.

tf.s: Ox starts with the letter b.

boxes.q: m – o – p. What's the word?
Which question do we ask about a thing?
boxes.why: We ask What's this? about things.

boxes.q: What's this? The teacher writes on it.
boxes.why: The teacher writes on the whiteboard.

boxes.q: Which word starts with the same sound as octopus?
boxes.why: Olive and octopus both start with o.

boxes.q: Your partner asks: What's this? You see a door. You say…
boxes.why: Say It's a and the name of the thing.

boxes.q: h – o – p. What's the word?
Which is NOT a classroom thing?
boxes.why: An octopus lives in the sea, not in the classroom.

hunt.q: A fruit that starts with o
An animal that starts with o

mcq.q: What sound do we hear at the start of on?
mcq.why: On starts with the o sound.

mcq.q: Which one is a word for a classroom thing?
mcq.why: A whiteboard is in the classroom.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with o?
mcq.why: Olive starts with o. Sock and mop have o in the middle.

mcq.q: Which answer goes with What's this?
mcq.why: It's a … tells what the thing is.

mcq.q: Your partner holds up a book. What's this?
Listen: s – o – ck. What's the word?
You want to know what a thing is. What do you ask?
o: Can I go to the toilet?
mcq.why: What's this? asks about a thing.

mcq.q: Which word has the o sound in the middle?
mcq.why: M-o-p has o in the middle.

mcq.q: Which group of words all start with o?
mcq.why: On, ox and octopus all start with o.

mcq.q: Your friend points to the teacher. Which question is right?
mcq.why: The teacher is a person, so we ask Who's this?
